meta.name: cloud-run-basics
meta.description: Manages Cloud Run services, jobs, and worker pools. Use when you need to deploy applications responding to HTTP requests (services), run event-triggered or scheduled tasks (jobs), or handle always-on pull-based background processing (worker pools).

copy.tagline: 管理 Cloud Run 服务、任务和工作池的部署与运维
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Cloud Run 上部署 HTTP 服务或运行事件驱动任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage Cloud Run services, jobs, and worker pools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy HTTP services or run event-driven tasks on Cloud Run

howto.what: 部署和管理 Cloud Run 服务、任务和工作者池。服务响应 HTTP 请求，任务执行一次性或定时作业，工作者池处理后台拉取任务。
howto.when: 当需要部署 HTTP 应用（服务）、运行事件触发或定时任务（作业）、或处理常驻后台拉取工作负载（工作者池）时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署一个 Cloud Run 服务，使用容器镜像 hello:latest。
say.note: 将部署一个名为 hello 的服务。

say.text: 创建一个 Cloud Run 任务，镜像为 job:latest，任务数 5。
say.note: 将创建一个任务并立即执行。

say.text: 部署一个工作者池，使用本地源码。
say.note: 将从当前目录源码构建并部署。

howto.what_en: Manages Cloud Run services, jobs, and worker pools. Services respond to HTTP requests, jobs run one-time or scheduled tasks, worker pools handle always-on pull-based background workloads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to deploy HTTP applications (services), run event-triggered or scheduled tasks (jobs), or handle always-on pull-based background processing (worker pools).

say_en.text: Deploy a Cloud Run service using container image hello:latest.
say_en.note: Will deploy a service named hello.

say_en.text: Create a Cloud Run job with image job:latest and 5 tasks.
say_en.note: Will create and execute the job.

say_en.text: Deploy a worker pool from local source.
say_en.note: Will build and deploy from current directory.
